adoption_scope: Guidance and implementation defaults; not media, motion, science, platform or publication approval.

design.direction: 真实写实连续主画面；结构、光影、材质、空间与动作可信，工具按镜头选择
design.design_board_scope: record the actual current board version/hash and reviewed scope; the bundled reference selects appearance only
design.style_reference_scope: legacy_2d_only; not approval for realistic main footage

video_generation.assembly_input: Actual locally generated or rendered video files, including Blender controlled_3d output; existing complete picture tracks may use the verified local postproduction adapter.
video_generation.alternative_path: Follow topic routing or current explicit user scope; preserve an already locked project choice and actual permissions.
video_generation.default_scope: Other suitable natural/life topics when engineering routing and an explicit current project choice do not take precedence.

engineering.when: Precise engineering structures, sections, assembly, mechanism motion and continuous spatial localization benefit from controllable geometry.

audio.speaker: Serena
audio.instruct: 自然口语，像认真向朋友连续解释一个有趣现象。用平实、连贯的语气讲清因果，重音和停顿跟随当前语义。不要朗诵腔，不要逐字停顿，普通话清晰。
audio.runtime_parameters: Use the confirmed project's verified runtime; local adapter examples apply only when that adapter is explicitly selected.

captions.scale_policy: Same aspect ratio: multiply vertical values by output_height/1920, record rounding; different layout requires review.
captions.exclude: Published or already-approved-for-publication versions are not changed by this setting.
captions.move_scope: Captions and tight background only; document any necessary local label reflow.
captions.scope: legacy_portrait_revision_only; not the default for new landscape work

delivery.default_scope: Future new productions and explicitly requested landscape work only; preserve approved/published portrait identities and media.

permissions: Follow the current task, version approvals, pauses and cancellations; config adoption grants none.

platform_sync.scope: current series only; no new platform authority

daily_counting.unpublished_inventory: not_automatically_eligible; determine new-work scope from source/version evidence

operations.scope: Historical series planning defaults; apply targets only when the current task requests this production cadence. No task or automation is created by loading this Skill.

landscape_captions.policy: Design against actual scene and platform, then inspect exported text and tight backgrounds. Never scale legacy portrait Y coordinates into this layout.

shared_3d_library.storage: Versioned copies of editable used assets with dependencies, source/rights, scale/axes, preview and SHA manifest; retain project originals.
shared_3d_library.verification: Read back destination files and compare SHA before claiming archived; unavailable NAS remains local_pending_sync.
shared_3d_library.quality_boundary: Library availability is not current scientific, visual, hearing or publication approval; superseded and rejected variants are not default reusable assets.
shared_3d_library.selection_scope: current_engine is current only within its version index; multiple indexed versions remain candidates, not an automatically approved global latest.
shared_3d_library.supporting_assets: Baseline sources, rebuild-only intermediate models and cover layouts are non-default roles; list only when explicitly requested.
